name: chargebee-test-site-email-review
description: "JusPrin Chargebee test site (jusprinv2-test) can't deliver email to k@obico.io; how to get its rendered emails to Kenneth for review, and how its notification editor behaves."
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: e80979d6-dfac-4fbe-a0ad-cbfede2b39e1
  modified: 2026-11-11T22:02:09.230Z
---

The jusprinv2-test Chargebee site sends as jusprin-support@obico.io, and Gmail
bounces every one of its emails to obico.io addresses under obico.io's DMARC
policy (550 5.7.26). "Send test mail" and the email log's Forward both bounce.
Test sends are limited to obico.io addresses and 50 a day.

**How to apply:**
- The rendered email is in Logs › Email Logs: click a row; the preview is an
  iframe whose `srcdoc` is the full HTML (`/sent_mail/<id>/preview` returns an
  error without the app's headers). Close each preview (`i.cn-glyph-close`)
  before opening the next, or the iframe keeps the old email.
- To get the HTML out: Chrome blocks page→localhost fetches behind a Local
  Network Access prompt; instead inject a button whose click handler calls
  `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, click it with the computer tool, then
  `pbpaste`. Clear the clipboard afterwards.
- Then send the copies from k@obico.io to itself with gog (`--body-html`).
- Notification editor: Edit opens a draft (new id); after "Import HTML", set
  the CodeMirror (`.CodeMirror`.CodeMirror.setValue) and the plain-text
  textarea, then type one real key in the editor so the draft saves and
  Publish appears. Reopening a published id shows it read-only.
- Test mails use Chargebee sample data (plan "Basic"), so `{{#plan.id = …}}`
  blocks for JusPrin plans render nothing in them; check those with a real
  checkout's email log entry.

Set up 2026-11-11 on both jusprinv2-test and live jusprinv2: 20 emails on
(Obico TSD's set plus "Subscription is changed"), welcome and credit-pack emails
rewritten. Live templates are copied word for word except the logo URL, which
points at the live site's own copy of the same image. Publishing a draft also
switches that email on. Each notification has a "push to live" action
(/notifications/<id>/push_to_live_ui), unused so far.
- To compare sites: fetch each /notifications/<group>/view page and read
  `.cn-engage__container` rows (checkbox = on/off); fetch /notifications/<id>/edit
  and hash the `custom_html_template`/`custom_text_template` textareas.
- On a freshly loaded page, wait ~3 s before clicking toggles from JS, or the
  click doesn't register.

description: "2026-11-05 who draws Account's billing part; Kenneth agreed \"server\" on a premise I got wrong (server already sends prices); re-asked; designs exist on canvas boards 4a-4c, 5a-5b, 7a-7b"
metadata:

---

On 2026-11-05 I told Kenneth that if the app draws Account's plan price, a price change needs an app release. He agreed the server should draw it. That premise was wrong: `/ent/jusprin/v2/account` (tsd-enterprise `ledger/account.py`) already sends `prices` (plans with cents, the pack, credit cents) and `plan.obico_discount`, so an app-drawn price follows the server's settings with no release. I corrected it the same day and re-asked; check the conversation or ask before treating either answer as settled.

What is designed (canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/ENCtdaz7gjynfbcy4JYbWJ): 5a/5b pricing page in the browser (Pay as you go $10/500, Hobby $10/750, Workshop $20/1000 + Standard free; $8/$16 for Obico Premium); 4a-4c Preferences › Account drawn as one app section, including "Workshop · $16 a month", Renews, discount line, Manage plan, purchase and reward rows, Alerts checkbox; 7a/7b savings alert above the composer; board 9 "+500 credits" line after buying.

What exists: `/ent/jusprin/pricing/` is still the v1 page (Free + Unlimited $6.99/$59.99, Chargebee checkout only for `jusprin-unlimited-*`); the app's "Get more credits" opens it.

**Why:** Kenneth's 11-02 reason for server pages: prices change often, no app release for a price change, old copies must not show old prices.
Related: [[one-action-to-get-more-credits]], [[v1-subscribers-grandfathered]], [[credits-boards-live-on-flow-pages]].
